description: Return the public profiles of two catalog projects side by side, identified by host and two owner/repo slugs; a former slug resolves as it does for get_project. The response presents each project's facts and health bands; it draws no conclusion and names no winner. What each band means is published on the catalog's methodology page (/methodology) and returned by get_methodology. The pair is refused when either slug matches no project in this catalog or names a project with insufficient measured signals, or when both name the same repository; the refusal names the argument, a or b, at fault. A project on gitlab is published with its health signals unavailable, so it is refused here and is returned only by get_project. Read-only. Serves catalog schema v1.

a.description: The owner/repo slug of the first project.

b.description: The owner/repo slug of the second project.

name: compare_projects
